name: How long does a full bathroom remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full bathroom remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a full bathroom remodel can range from 3 to 8 weeks, depending on the complexity of the project and the availability of materials. Projects involving significant layout changes, custom cabinetry, or extensive tile work will naturally take longer. Delays in material delivery or unexpected structural issues can also extend the timeline.
